style_figure: Photograph of one premium hand-painted collectible miniature figure with heroic compact proportions, serious and highly detailed. The figure is short and very wide: it is only two and a half heads tall. The helmet is oversized, as large as the whole torso, and takes up more than one third of the figure's height. Massive round shoulder shells make the shoulders nearly twice as wide as the helmet. Thick short arms with large gloved fists. Very short thick legs, no longer than the helmet is tall, ending in big heavy boots. Matte realistic paint with crisp edge highlights and fine panel-line shading. Stern, serious mood. Full figure standing directly on the ground with no base, front three-quarter view, centred, plain pure white background, soft even studio light.

items.prompt: Subject: an agent in a sleek moulded protection suit from a 1950s vision of the future. Smooth segmented plates that follow the body, with a sculpted chest plate, ribbed flexible joints at the waist, elbows and knees, and a raised collar ring. Colours: bright signal red plates on the helmet, chest, shoulder shells, forearms, thighs and boots; matte black on the joints, sides, upper arms, gloves and undersuit; no white, no silver. Smooth domed helmet in bright red that fully covers the head, with one large glossy black visor and small round ear housings. No chest light, no crest, no antenna. Holds a short rounded carbine in one hand, pointed at the ground.

Subject: an agent in a sleek moulded flight suit from a 1950s vision of the future. Smooth segmented plates that follow the body, with a sculpted chest plate, ribbed flexible joints at the waist, elbows and knees, and a raised collar ring. Colours: bright signal red plates on the helmet, chest, shoulder shells, forearms, thighs and boots; matte black on the joints, sides, upper arms, gloves and undersuit; no white, no silver. A flight pack on the back: two large black cylindrical jet turbines with red intake rings that rise clearly above both shoulders, and two short swept red wings that stick out sideways behind the arms. Smooth domed helmet in bright red that fully covers the head, with one large glossy black visor and small round ear housings. No chest light, no crest. Holds a short rounded carbine in one hand, pointed at the ground.

Subject: a civil-defence security agent of a 1950s vision of the future in plain issue gear, clearly less advanced than armour. Black quilted fabric coverall, a short hard chest plate and round shoulder caps in bright signal red enamel, wide black belt with rounded pouches, black ribbed rubber gloves, tall black boots with red toe caps. Rounded open-face helmet in bright red enamel with a black rim and a dark tinted goggle strip covering the eyes, stern mouth visible. Holds a compact rounded carbine with a black barrel shroud and small cooling fins, pointed at the ground.
